# Phase 3 loader fixtures

Synthetic deterministic installer/profile fixtures. They exercise Graphene-owned normalization and hostile-archive policy only; they are not upstream smoke evidence. `forge-modern-fixture.jar` and `neoforge-modern-fixture.jar` use the same normalized processor schema deliberately to prove convergence into one preparation model.

Additional hostile archive-type fixtures cover Unix symlink and special-file entry metadata (`symlink-entry.jar`, `special-file.jar`).
